notes.title: My latest game, Bucket Detective, is 25% off!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9563359/efd41de858ab2535b70db791f66d9a346f8f7221.png[/img]

If you haven't bought Bucket Detective yet, now's the time! It's 25% off for the next seven days. Buying my games directly supports me, allowing me to make more games. So if you like my games but wish there were more, throw cash at the problem.

Here's a nice write up of Bucket Detective whet your appetite: [url=https://waypoint.vice.com/en_us/article/bucket-detective-the-story-of-a-a-sad-asshole-who-joined-a-cult]https://waypoint.vice.com/en_us/article/bucket-detective-the-story-of-a-a-sad-asshole-who-joined-a-cult[/url]

- jesse
